unit_label: Section 9: Relativ-ganze Bereiche G_{n rho} aus Polynomen
translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice. The English control slice was used only as a sanity witness for relative-integrality and Hilbert Problem 14 vocabulary; this unit was not edited from another target-language draft.

technical_exclusions.disposition: Section 10 and later Paper 06 content; not included in this checkpoint.

segment_summaries.content: Section heading: relatively integral domains of polynomials.
segment_summaries.choices: Introduces the new relative-integrality lane as `відносно ціла область` / `относительно целая область` / `relativno cěla oblast`, parallel to the introduction's relatively integral functions.

segment_summaries.content: Defines a relatively integral polynomial domain by condition 4a: the domain contains a quotient F:G exactly when the quotient is whole in the indeterminates, hence a polynomial.
segment_summaries.choices: `ganz in den Unbestimmten` is rendered as `ціла за невизначеними` / `цело по неопределенным` / `cěly po neopreděljenyh`; the colon quotient notation is preserved.

segment_summaries.content: Proves equivalence between relatively integral domains and the totality of polynomials in a rational-function field; includes the rho=0 coefficient-domain footnote.
segment_summaries.choices: The source's slightly awkward coefficient-domain footnote is preserved cautiously as elements of the coefficient domain/area omega, with a review flag for later source-control comparison.

segment_summaries.content: Identifies Noether's definition with Hilbert's integrality domains of relatively integral functions, starting from a rational basis.
segment_summaries.choices: Hilbert's German title is retained in the footnote; target prose names the 1900 Paris lecture without over-translating the bibliographic title.

segment_summaries.content: For relatively integral domains the common-divisor definition simplifies: a common divisor belongs to G iff it is a common divisor in G, because the quotients then follow from 4a.
segment_summaries.choices: The Section 8 divisor vocabulary is reused, confirming continuity of `спільний дільник` / `общий делитель` / `obči dělitelj`.

segment_summaries.content: Defines algebraically integral with respect to G and relatively algebraically integral; reduces the definition to the irreducible equation by the extended Gauss theorem.
segment_summaries.choices: `Algebraisch-ganz in bezug auf G` becomes `алгебраїчно ціла відносно G`, `алгебраически целая относительно G`, and `algebraično cěla vzhodno k G`; Interslavic uses `děljiva črez` for divisibility after visual-review correction.

segment_summaries.content: Defines the smallest containing relatively integral domain of J and relates its involution form/basis to that of J by splitting off at most a common divisor; includes the J22 example.
segment_summaries.choices: `abzuspalten` is rendered as separating/extracting the common divisor, with Interslavic `odděliti`; the example formulas remain displayed in the footnote.

segment_summaries.content: Shows that the mapping domain of a relatively integral domain need not itself be relatively integral; specialization may turn a non-polynomial quotient into a polynomial.
segment_summaries.choices: `Abbildungsbereich` continues as `область відображення` / `область отображения` / `oblast odobraženja`; final Interslavic wording was corrected to `može vpolně byti polinomom`.

render_and_visual_corrections.correction: The first Russian render placed only the tail of the final footnote on page 3. The Russian prose and final footnote were tightened without changing mathematical content, yielding a clean 2-page render.
render_and_visual_corrections.rationale: Avoids a dangling footnote tail and satisfies the standing page-fullness visual-inspection requirement.

render_and_visual_corrections.correction: `jest dělimo črez` was corrected to `jest děljiva črez`.
render_and_visual_corrections.rationale: The source requires an adjective meaning divisible by; `dělimo` was a visual-review catch before checkpoint packaging.

render_and_visual_corrections.correction: `može mnogo dobro byti polinomom` was corrected to `može vpolně byti polinomom`.
render_and_visual_corrections.rationale: Removes an overly literal German calque while preserving the mathematical point that specialization can indeed produce a polynomial.

cyrillic_manual_normalizations.correction: Generated deterministically from the corrected Latin Interslavic source after the two Latin wording corrections.
cyrillic_manual_normalizations.rationale: Latin remains the Interslavic source-of-truth; Cyrillic is a synchronized reader variant.

review_flags: `relativno cěla oblast` is deliberately transparent and parallel to `relativno cěle funkcije`; final Interslavic authority review should confirm adjective agreement and whether an alternative to `relativno` is preferred.
`vzhodno k` is reused for `in bezug auf`; this keeps continuity with prior sections but should be reviewed for mathematical naturalness in the semi-constructed register.
`koeficientna oblast` versus `koeficientno polje` remains a source-sensitive issue because the German footnote says `Koeffizientenbereich Ω` in a rho=0 edge case.
`vpolně` was chosen for German `sehr wohl`; authority review may prefer another pan-Slavic adverb, but the corrected phrase is materially better than the discarded calque.
The Hilbert terminology cluster should be reviewed again in Section 10, where relatively integral domains of the first kind and integrality bases become central.
